QML estimators are asymptotically normally and strongly consistent for any sampling frequency for general discrete-time state space models as well as multivariate L\'{e}vy-driven CARMA processes, provided that certain identifiability assumptions are satisfied.

QML estimators of non-Gaussian linear state space models are consistent and asymptoticaly Gaussian distributed under a strong mixing condition on the state space process and, under suitable conditions, QML estimators for multivariate CARMA processes with equidistantly recorded observations converge to the true parameter values and are asymptotically Gaussian distributed.
